invariants.name: source admission
invariants.contract: A successfully complete scan accounts for every selected supported observation or explicitly reports exclusion/incompleteness. Limits and unknown schemas cannot silently prove absence.

invariants.name: identity and ownership
invariants.contract: One logical observation has one declared canonical owner. Copies deduplicate only with evidence; independent devices/accounts never lose disjoint usage.

invariants.name: merge and correction
invariants.contract: Accepted state is deterministic under the declared order. Rebuild equals committed state. A correction removes precisely its prior contribution, including changed day/model/coverage/denominator.

invariants.name: exact quantities
invariants.contract: No overflow, rounding ambiguity, subset double-counting or integer precision loss. Unknown, estimated and measured zero remain distinct across all representations.

invariants.name: coverage
invariants.contract: Coverage is scoped to source, interval, metric and population; merging evidence cannot invent completeness. A parser's success or a record's presence is not enumeration proof.

invariants.name: durability
invariants.contract: Cursor, facts, associations, revision and outbox commit consistently. Success survives qualified restart; uncertain outcome retains enough evidence for reconciliation.

invariants.name: network effects
invariants.contract: Retried delivery has at-most-once accounting effect. Acknowledgment refers to exact identity/sequence/hash/revision. A stale response cannot clear newer work.

invariants.name: authority
invariants.contract: Every sensitive effect uses current account/device/generation authority. Revocation, transfer and restore fence stale actors at declared linearization points.

invariants.name: read semantics
invariants.contract: Reads do not mutate persistent state; pagination and projection reads represent a declared snapshot and detect stale cursors.

invariants.name: projection equivalence
invariants.contract: Optimized rollups and queries equal an independent fold of canonical contributions, including correction, migration, deletion and reindex.

invariants.name: privacy
invariants.contract: Only explicitly allowed numeric facts/public identities cross each boundary. No prompts, paths, tool arguments, credentials or private labels leak through errors, exports, caches or telemetry.

invariants.name: deletion and consent
invariants.contract: Withdrawal/erasure cannot be undone by delayed work or restored backups beyond the explicitly retained control evidence and documented public cache bound.

invariants.name: resources and liveness
invariants.contract: Every allocation/I/O/query/retry/retention path is bounded. Under stated recovery/fairness assumptions valid work can progress; refusal has a usable recovery path.

invariants.name: product fidelity
invariants.contract: Dashboard, CLI, CSV, charts and accessible tables express the same selected facts, units, cohort and coverage.

invariants.name: supply chain and deployment
invariants.contract: Qualified artifact identity, source, toolchains and deployed service identity agree. Feature flags reflect current qualification, not historical source-test success.

invariants.name: benchmark integrity
invariants.contract: Comparisons preserve benchmark/config/version distinctions and dated evidence; missing measurements are not zeros, and personal usage is not benchmark capability.

findings.obligation: Reject conflicting known owners atomically; preserve unknown-to-known enrichment and exact replay; migration must be explicit.
Disjoint 120 and 15 remain 135: snapshot days are owned per device, a device shadows only its own retained heads, and reads sum devices.
An expired lease with a live continuation cannot prove drain or permit new-epoch visibility.
All persistent maintenance participates in drain; reads have explicit restored-state visibility.
Event bytes unchanged by mtime manipulation preserve in-range observations.
Every omitted selected source is a bounded refusal or explicit incomplete diagnostic.
Replacement covers precisely a fetched complete interval; outside-range records survive.
Every warning survives persistence and historical schema migration.
A revoked device keeps its published days and its later uploads refuse; no writer slot exists to transfer, so a successor device publishes its own partition immediately.
An admitted 100001-record population remains representable by the corresponding response.
Superseded operations cannot revive or double-charge retained capacity.
Ordinary read issues no persistent insert/update/delete; maintenance has explicit owner.
Retained checkpoints distinguish migration trust from verified full replay; reference fold agrees.
Owned descendants settle within deadline without signaling an unrelated or reused process group.
100 cache-read and 900 cache-write input yields 10% only for complete category coverage.
Disjoint reported and estimated observations yield no savings/difference claim.
Display source record grain and duration basis; total/source-duration rate never implies decode speed.
Failed collection remains observable without replacing retained good measurements.
Every advertised adapter has versioned executed fixture qualification; excluded tests never count as run.
Indexed bounded queries and counters equal independent full recomputation under correction.

Owned SQL/R2 surfaces are discovered; executable logical budgets never masquerade as physical bounds. Native read-only recovery must support the same database byte bound as writer admission; this Phase 1A dependency is part of the broader capacity obligation.
Export/erase/transfer/recovery are functional and preserve authority across delayed and restored work.
Identity change, bfcache and late replies cannot expose another authority generation; local files survive.
Typed attributable numeric facts support distribution/lineage metrics with no content upload.
Current consent and freshness bound every public projection; withdrawn/erased state cannot resurrect.
Claim inventory cites exact source/artifact/live evidence and does not promote dated activation to current proof.

proofClaim: No proof established by this inventory; each evidence artifact must declare scope and assumptions.
